reviews.author: Dylan Watson
reviews.text: WHATEVER YOU DO DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY The absolute worst company I have ever done business with. Paid $3,700 for a 20 gallon pressure tank and a 1/2 hp submersible installed. Apparently, there’s a leak in between the two lines and instead of fixing it while they were here and had plenty of time left in the day they left it and never planned to come back and fix it. when I called the office to talk about it, they rudely came up with excuses and then told me to call another company. I have a newborn at home with no water.

reviews.author: Robert Yutzy
reviews.text: Recently got a shower and hot water heater installed, and both projects went very well. We have used Buckner Plumbing for many years, and have always been satisfied. Easy to deal with, professional and and reliable.

reviews.author: danny pressley
reviews.text: Thank you Buckner Plumbing and home Repair for the great job on building and structural designing our our new steps…they exceeded my expectations! And the customer service was …on time and quick, professional, very clean during and after the job ! Big shout out to Drew and the crew at Buckner’s !!!

reviews.author: Patti Wood
reviews.text: I contacted Buckner Plumbing to replace an outside faucet. They scheduled me in less than a week! Two very nice, knowledgeable young men replaced the leaking faucet in less than half an hour. Very reasonable. I appreciate the prompt service!

reviews.author: Steve Boehm
reviews.text: We discovered on Saturday morning of Labor Day weekend that our water pressure would go to zero and then recover a few minutes later. Not a good situation anytime but especially on a holiday weekend with a house filled with 14 people (including a newborn!) I called Buckner’s number and got a callback from Eddie who had the emergency service shift for the weekend. He walked me through a diagnostic Saturday night and isolated them problem as a bad pressure switch which he committed to replacing Sunday PM. He called me Sunday 30 minutes before arriving, showed up on time, and replaced the switch/recharged the pressure tank. Water service is house is better now than it was new. Eddie and Buckner get 5 stars from us for reliable, timely, and friendly service. Thanks Eddie!

reviews.author: Julia Quinn
reviews.text: Just a note to express our appreciation for the good service your firm has given us. In the past few months your good folks have replaced our well pump, a sewer pump, repaired a water leak and more. Just this past week Eddie and Noah fixed a water leak, etc. They did a great job, were friendly, helpfully and cleaned up before leaving.. Amy also was extremely helpful as always. Our thanks, Edwin and Julia Quinn

reviews.author: Stewart G
reviews.text: I was in need of after hours repairs (after 6pm) on a toilet line that wasnt supplying water. I could "hear" it leaking under the floor in the crawl space area. Due to this, I had to shut off the water main to the entire house. I began googling for after hours plumbers in the area and made several phone calls to atleast 5-6 of them. After leaving messages on voicemils and being told by two who did call back they wouldn't be able to assist me this evening or even the next day as they were all booked up full, I called Buckner Plumbing and Heating, left a voice message and within 2 minutes, I was contacted by Eddie who, after I explained to him my situation, responded within the hour, assessed the problem and had us fixed up in no time! He was friendly and informative showing me exactly what the problem was. This ended up not being a in and out fix due to how the builders installed the plumbing originally but he powered thru their mess and got it done for what was also, felt was a very reasonable price considering the after hours call and what needed to be done. Eddie, Thanks for coming, you're our HERO and to Buckner, You have a great employee there! Got his card and ill call him again for any future plumbing needs!!

reviews.author: Mike G
reviews.text: Caught tech in several lies when they come to install a hot water heater. He left when asked about the discrepancy and said find someone else to do it. Contacted management and she just covered for the tech saying he just missed. This was the second time in two years they have been to my home for the same problem and she stated the first guy missed it also. Just wanted to upsell.

reviews.author: Shawn Orr
reviews.text: We had a leak in our basement from a pipe that flooded our basement on Friday evening, We called to get them to come out Monday to help us out. Eddie came out and found the problem and had us fixed and water back on in about 30 minutes. He was very courteous and efficient. We would recommend Buckner plumbing.

reviews.author: Shawn Boatright
reviews.text: I paid $180 for 10 min work. My shower valve was leaking. We took the wall down and everything was exposed and ready for them to repair. They came out, looked at it and said you need a valve... this took 2 min. They had to go back to the shop to get the valve.....why there was not a valve on the plumber work truck is beyond me as I had told them where it was leaking when the shower was turned on when I called. I was charged $140 for labor and $30 for the part. When I questioned the bill amt I was told that the labor charge starts when they leave the shop. I was charged for the trip to my house, back to the shop to get the valve and then for 10 min work. I am so hurt and disappointed. I talked to many people who said I was definitely taken advantage of. As a Woman I have come to expect that in this area. Polite people but not fair with labor charges! You may want to see how far you are from their shop before having them come out ....I am only 13 miles from their shop!! Update: so before We repaired the wall we turned the shower on to make sure the leak was fixed. Guess what! It wasn’t!! I had to take the connection apart and put thread tape on. Now its fixed!! Amazed that a reputable plumbing co didn’t even use thread tape to assure no leaks!! SMH!

reviews.author: Martin Zillmann
reviews.text: Polite, responsive, professional, knowledgeable, and reasonably priced. They came out quickly to fix a leak at our pressure tank. Buckner Plumbing will definitely be my "go to" vendor for plumbing repairs.

reviews.author: Averyl Basolo
reviews.text: Eddie and Shawn were awesome!! Even with the mess in WNC after Helene, they got right out and helped my family by putting in a new Water Heater. Thanks to them, my kids can have hot baths.

reviews.author: Colleen Moore
reviews.text: I had a very good experience with Buckner Plumbing. They spent a while day at my house and fixed a ton of stuff. The lady that answers the phone is very nice, knowledgeable and super helpful. I'll definitely use them any time I have plumbing issues (which hopefully won't be for a while!)

reviews.author: Dana Anderson
reviews.text: Our well pump went out. I called and called all over but the only appointment I could get was for the next day and about an hour later the receptionist called and asked if it were ok for a crew to come on up I said yes please!!! Two fellas came up from Marion which is an easy 30 min drive one way!!!! They came looked and had to go pick up another part. They got back and got it done!!! Yay what a great company!!!! I can’t thank y’all enough!!!!!

reviews.author: Lauren Blank
reviews.text: Opened my crawl space door to find water and called Buckner Plumbing. Amy has excellent customer service !!! They sent out a wonderful man that fixed the outside faucet, problem solved. Thanks so much for really great service and professionalism.

reviews.author: Carol Statham
reviews.text: Thank goodness this company is around! After almost 2 months of not being able to get anyone to come out (or even return a phone call!) they got us fixed up when no one locally seemed interested. We are new to this area and will definitely use them again when the need arises. THANK YOU!

reviews.author: Tony Vincent
reviews.text: $242.00 to install a new faucet ( provided by me) seemed exorbitant. That said, the repair guys were here and gone in 20 minutes and did a fine job. Just be prepared to pay a premium.

reviews.author: Gail Morgan
reviews.text: Our water went out on a Friday evening,I called Buckner Plumbing and Saturday afternoon their technician called. They pulled our pump out and replaced it.They were so polite and professional and we really appreciate their hard work.They did a great job and we will use them again when we have a problem.

reviews.author: Joycelyn Tate
reviews.text: I had plumbers to come to check for water leak, they checked all around the house and under the house. They did not find any leaks charged me 113.00 and left. Had another plumber from different business to come he found two leaks and fixed them. I have had good service from Buckner in the past but I am very displeased with this service. The water leaks were right where they supposedly checked.

reviews.author: Caitlin Charlton
reviews.text: After googling plumbers in my area I called Buckner 's and made an appointment. The men who came out were on-time, professional, wore their masks (if that something that concerns you), and were very informative. They explained the problem thoroughly and fixed it in a very timely manner. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lesa Silver
reviews.text: Eddie at Buckner Plumbing is great! He just wouldn’t quit until he found the problem at a local store. He sure was our hero that day! Thanks Eddie!

reviews.author: Lyle Justice
reviews.text: Unless your pockets are deep and the job not done then this the company for you. Charge me 411.88 dollars to come out. I couldn't make it to my mom's house before they said it was done. On second attempt they thought they had found the problem but it would cost me another 600.00 dollars. I called another plumber who charged me 250.00 to fix it right. They have got my last dollar but go for if you don't mind the exorbitant pricing and poor service.

reviews.author: Sandra McKinney
reviews.text: Thank you for the prompt attention you gave to my aunt and her water problem. You were prompt, courteous and wasted no time fixing the problem. She is very sick at this time and this experience has brightened our day! Thank you again and may God bless you and your business for the kindness that you showed to her.

reviews.author: Gary Mikami
reviews.text: I had an issue on a Saturday (Murphy)...Called Buckner, left a brieg msg, got a call back, suggesting I call a septic company, based on experience. Spot On!!!! They saved me from a double dip in charges, and providing me with useful information. I will always call these guys for any plumbing issue. And you can't go wrong with this company.

reviews.author: Alan Collensberg III
reviews.text: Some of the best customer service in McDowell County by far! They restored service to my bathroom in a timely manner! The rates are reasonable for a licensed plumbing company! Thank you!

reviews.author: Mark Knapp
reviews.text: Dustin did a great job, and he is so courteous. We appreciate the great service and highly recommend this company and crew.

reviews.author: Dwight James
reviews.text: If you want it done right the first time, or need the right part the first time, this is the place to go to or call. Great service from great folks that have been in business probably longer than any plumbing company in McDowell County!

reviews.author: Jerry Mckinney
reviews.text: Highly recommended this company. They are professional and courteous their repairs was top notch and they showed up on time. Would recommend to anyone looking for any plumbing need.

reviews.author: Will Smith
reviews.text: I recommend Buckner Plumbing! Great work, fast and economical! Called to have a water heater installed and they were there the very next morning! Great company Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Sandra Scalese
reviews.text: Prices for services set. Staff is extremely friendly and knowledgeable. Can make payments for services rendered . Work is completed quickly.

reviews.author: Kayla J
reviews.text: Corey was great to work with. He was super knowledgeable and I appreciated him coming out late to fix my water issue.

reviews.author: Jennifer Duncan
reviews.text: These ppl charge widows in wheelchairs $400 to dig a 3ft hole and replace six inches of pipe. Twice. On weekdays. Disgusting!

reviews.author: Harriet J Foster
reviews.text: For 2 years we have had problems with our water going on and off. Buckner was the only ones who took 30 minutes and fixed our problem. Thank you, thank you.

reviews.author: Tyler Cook
reviews.text: Fast and friendly. Can't ask for a better company in McDowell County. I always recommend them on my jobs.

reviews.author: tim Chapman
reviews.text: They talk with about a project and help me solve it . I didn't buy anything from them but next time I can use their services they b the first I go to. Thanks for the advice
